[[Reed Stalker]]s are violent [[plant]] [[creature]]s that inhabit the swamps and marshes of [[Kryta]].  They attack in numbers, but the real danger comes from their [[mesmer]] [[skill]]s, which make them dangerous to attack, and equally dangerous to ignore.
